title: Measuring the Depth of LLM Unlearning via Activation Patching
abstract: arXiv:2605.24614v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Large language model (LLM) unlearning has emerged as a crucial post-hoc mechanism for privacy protection and AI safety, yet auditing whether target knowledge is truly erased remains challenging. Existing output-level metrics fail to detect when this knowledge remains recoverable from internal representations. Recent white-box studies reveal such residual knowledge but often rely on auxiliary training or dataset-specific adaptations, leaving no generalizable metric. We close this gap with the Unlearning Depth Score (UDS), a metric that quantifies the mechanistic depth of unlearning via activation patching. UDS first identifies layers that encode the target knowledge using a retain model baseline, then measures how much of it is erased in the unlearned model on a 0-1 scale. In a meta-evaluation across 20 metrics on 150 unlearned models spanning 8 methods, UDS achieves the highest faithfulness and robustness, confirming our causal

translated_title: 通过激活修补测量大语言模型遗忘的深度
translated_abstract: 大语言模型遗忘已成为隐私保护和人工智能安全的关键事后机制，然而审计目标知识是否真正被擦除仍然具有挑战性。现有的输出层面指标无法检测这些知识是否仍可从内部表示中恢复。近期的白盒研究揭示了这种残留知识的存在，但通常依赖于辅助训练或针对特定数据集的适配，缺乏可泛化的评估指标。我们提出了遗忘深度分数来填补这一空白，这是一个通过激活修补来量化遗忘机制深度的指标。UDS首先使用保留模型作为基线来识别编码目标知识的网络层，然后在0-1的量表上测量遗忘模型中这些知识被擦除的程度。在涵盖8种遗忘方法的150个遗忘模型上对20个指标进行的元评估中，UDS实现了最高的忠实度和鲁棒性，证实了我们的因果
tldr: 提出遗忘深度分数（UDS），一种基于激活修补的新指标，通过量化大语言模型内部表示中知识擦除的机制深度，解决了现有输出层指标无法检测残留知识、白盒方法缺乏泛化性的审计难题。
en_tdlr: Proposes the Unlearning Depth Score (UDS), a novel activation-patching-based metric that quantifies the mechanistic depth of knowledge erasure in LLMs' internal representations, addressing the limitations of output-level metrics and non-generalizable white-box approaches in auditing unlearning.
